evals.prompt: Create a single-storey steel portal frame, 3 m tall with a 6 m span and fixed connections.
expectations: Creates a subfolder under /models with a model.ts file
3 lines: left column [1,2], beam [2,3], right column [3,4]
Fixed point-support on points 1 and 4
generic-member placeholder assigned to lines 1, 2 and 3 (no section was given)
Defines gridLines (grid-system) at the column lines (x = 0 and x = 6 m) and the base and eaves levels (z = 0 and z = 3 m)
Does not add loads or load cases that were not requested
models/index.ts re-exports the model so platform.ts picks it up

evals.prompt: Read the attached Cornerstone Pressure Washing section drawing and generate an Awatif model of the steel truss building from it.
expectations: Creates a subfolder under /models with a model.ts file
Reads the drawing dimensions: 70'-0" span (~21.34 m) between column lines A and B
Column height of 19'-6 3/4" (~5.96 m) and truss underside at 16'-8" (~5.08 m), converted from imperial to metres
Roof pitch of 4:12 (ridge ~3.56 m above the eaves), symmetric about mid-span, in the XZ plane (y = 0)
Two columns, one at x = 0 and one at x = span, with points at base, truss bottom chord and truss top chord
Truss modelled with top chord, bottom chord, verticals and diagonal web members as lines (not a single beam)
Pinned or fixed point-support on the two column base points
Every line has a design entry: generic-member placeholder where the section is unknown (W16x67, HSS), the matching member template (steel, concrete or timber) only for a section Awatif supports
Defines gridLines (grid-system) at the column lines (x = 0 and x = 21.336 m) and the base, truss underside and column top levels (z = 0, 5.08 and 5.963 m)
Does not add loads or load cases that were not requested
models/index.ts re-exports the model so platform.ts picks it up

evals.prompt: Read the attached Cornerstone Pressure Washing analytical model screenshot and recreate it as an Awatif model.
expectations: Creates a subfolder under /models with a model.ts file
Uses the annotated dimensions in metres: 21.438 m between the column bases, 4.572 m column dimension, 0.250 m and 1.520 m overhangs
Roof pitch of 4:12 (ridge ~3.57 m above the eaves, ridge top chord at ~9.04 m), symmetric about mid-span, in the XZ plane (y = 0)
Top chord panels of ~1.695 m along the slope (~1.608 m in plan), bottom chord nodes offset ~1.07 m from the columns
Truss modelled as a Warren truss: top chord, bottom chord and zigzag web members as lines, with a vertical at the ridge
Left overhang of ~0.25 m and right overhang of ~1.52 m beyond the column lines, as unequal cantilevers
Bottom chord ends linked to the column by short link members (R1 plate), not merged into the column node
Pinned point-support on the two column base points
Every line has a design entry: generic-member placeholder for W8x48, HSS and the plate (none is a supported section)
Defines gridLines (grid-system) at the column lines (x = 0 and x = 21.438 m) and the main column node levels (z = 0, 4.572, 4.822 and 5.465 m)
Does not add loads or load cases that were not requested
models/index.ts re-exports the model so platform.ts picks it up

evals.prompt: Read the attached Hibbler frame example image and generate an Awatif model of the frame from it.
expectations: Creates a subfolder under /models with a model.ts file
Reads the drawing dimensions and converts them from feet to metres: beam at 16 ft (4.877 m), A to B 12 ft (3.658 m), 10 k load 8 ft further (x = 20 ft, 6.096 m), C 8 ft further (x = 28 ft, 8.534 m)
Beam A-B-C modelled in the XZ plane (y = 0) with a point at the 10 k load position, splitting the beam into 3 lines
Two vertical columns of 16 ft (4.877 m): E-B at x = 12 ft and D-C at x = 28 ft, with bases at z = 0
Fixed point-support at A (the wall)
Pinned (or fixed) point-support at the column bases E and D
2 k/ft distributed load (~29.19 kN/m) acting downward (global-z, negative) on the beam from A to B only
10 k point load (~44.48 kN) acting downward (Fz negative) at 8 ft left of C
Loads are assigned to a load case, and no loads or load cases beyond those in the image are added
Defines gridLines (grid-system) at the column lines and load position (x = 0, 3.658, 6.096 and 8.534 m) and the base and beam levels (z = 0 and 4.877 m)
Every line has a design entry: generic-member placeholder, since no section is given
models/index.ts re-exports the model so platform.ts picks it up
